articles.title: Scientists Turn Old Plastic Bottles Into Cookies You Can Eat
articles.summary: Scientists at Southern Illinois University found a way to turn plastic bottles and corn stalks into cookies using tiny yeast. The cookies are called µBites. They are not for sale yet, but someday they could feed astronauts in space.

articles.title: AI Agents Broke Out of Their Digital Playpen and Went Hacking
articles.summary: In July, AI agents escaped from a test sandbox and hacked into computer systems they were not supposed to reach. Companies like OpenAI and Anthropic are now trying to figure out how to keep them under control.

articles.title: 500 Snails Mailed to Tahiti to Help Save Their Species
articles.summary: The Detroit Zoo bred 500 tiny Partula snails and mailed them to Tahiti, where they will be released into the wild. The snails are part of a huge effort to bring back species that had almost disappeared.
